name: Data Analyzer: The product decides correctly whether it is running in a live environment
objective: Proves that settings identifying production, staging or a cloud container app count as 'deployed', and development/test/empty settings do not. Runs over 10 setting combinations.
precondition: Offline test harness; settings are passed in as made-up values, no real server or cloud is contacted.

steps.action: Ask whether each made-up settings set is a deployed environment.
steps.data: No settings; APP_ENV dev/local/test/development; APP_ENV prod/staging/PROD; APP_ENV dev with a cloud container app name; a cloud container app name alone
steps.expected: Not deployed for none and dev/local/test/development. Deployed for prod, staging, PROD (any case), and whenever the cloud container app name is present even if APP_ENV says dev.

name: Data Analyzer: The web page's backend address is chosen safely
objective: Proves that the screen finds the backend (API) address: local default when nothing is set, the configured address (trailing slash removed) when deployed, and an error when deployed with no or blank address.
precondition: Offline test harness; settings are passed in as made-up values, no real server or cloud is contacted.

steps.action: Resolve the address with no settings, and with production plus an address.
Resolve the address in production with none, and in a cloud container app with a blank (spaces) one.
steps.data: APP_ENV prod; container app name with '  '

name: Data Analyzer: The web page start-up check reports missing connection settings
objective: Proves that the start-up check lists what is missing (the API address and key) when deployed, and returns pass/fail exit codes (0 pass, 1 fail, 2 for misuse) accordingly.
precondition: Offline test harness; settings are passed in as made-up values, no real server or cloud is contacted. Environment settings are temporarily changed for the test.

steps.action: List configuration problems for different settings.
steps.data: No settings; APP_ENV prod; prod with an address and key
steps.expected: Empty list; exactly 2 problems; empty list.

steps.action: Run the start-up check with --check-ui under several settings.
steps.data: prod with nothing; prod with address and key; dev with no address; no option at all

name: Data Analyzer: The container start script runs the connection check before starting the web page
objective: Proves that in the container start script the configuration check line, which stops start-up on failure, appears before the line that launches the web page.
precondition: Offline; reads the start script file entrypoint.sh from the code.

steps.action: Find positions of the check command and the web-page launch command in the script.
steps.expected: The line 'python -m src.runtime_env --check-ui || exit 1' is present and comes before 'exec streamlit'.

name: Data Analyzer: The API refuses to start in a live environment without its access key
objective: Proves that when deployed (production, staging, or any cloud container app even with wrong APP_ENV) and no API key is set, the API application will not load. Runs over 4 settings combinations.
precondition: Each case starts a separate fresh Python process with no API key set and a made-up allowed web origin.

steps.action: Import the API server in a fresh process with deployed-style settings and an empty key.
steps.data: APP_ENV prod; APP_ENV staging; cloud container name only; cloud container name with APP_ENV dev
steps.expected: The process exits with a failure code and its error output contains 'DATA_ANALYZER_API_KEY is not set'.

name: Data Analyzer: The API may start without a key on a developer machine
objective: Proves that the safety stop above does not apply in local testing: with APP_ENV=test and no key, the API loads normally.
precondition: A fresh Python process with APP_ENV=test, empty API key.

steps.action: Import the API server in a fresh process.

name: Data Analyzer: The web page's deployment template points at the API using a secret reference
objective: Proves that the committed web-page deployment template has an https API address, takes the API key from a named secret, lists no secret values itself, and sets production mode.
precondition: Offline; reads the committed template deploy/aca/containerapp-ui.yaml.

steps.action: Read the template's environment settings and configuration.
steps.expected: API address starts with https://; API key setting refers to the secret 'data-analyzer-api-key' with no inline value; the configuration has no 'secrets' section; APP_ENV is 'prod'.

name: Data Analyzer: Web page and API templates use the same API-key secret name
objective: Proves that both deployment templates refer to the same secret name for the API key, so a key set once works for both.
precondition: Offline; reads templates containerapp.yaml and containerapp-ui.yaml.

steps.action: Compare the API key secret reference in both templates.
steps.expected: The secret reference names are identical.

name: Data Analyzer: Committed deployment templates contain no real infrastructure details or secret values
objective: Proves that the two committed templates contain nothing resembling a real cloud subscription path, ID code, registry address, app web address or storage address, and no secret values. Runs once per template.
precondition: Offline; reads each committed template (API and web page).

steps.action: Search each template's text for patterns of real-looking values, and check any listed secrets.
steps.data: containerapp.yaml and containerapp-ui.yaml; five patterns (subscription paths, ID codes, registry names, app addresses, storage addresses)
steps.expected: No pattern matches, and no secret entry carries a value.

name: Data Analyzer: Any cloud-container marker counts as deployed, whatever APP_ENV says
objective: Proves that any of four cloud container markers makes the product treat itself as deployed even if APP_ENV is dev, local, test, empty or absent, so it cannot silently use a local address. Runs over 4 markers x 5 APP_ENV values.
precondition: Offline test harness; settings are passed in as made-up values, no real server or cloud is contacted.

steps.action: For each combination, test the environment and resolve the API address.
steps.data: One cloud marker set to 'x' with APP_ENV absent, dev, local, test or empty
steps.expected: It is deployed; resolving the address raises a configuration error; the problems list mentions DATA_ANALYZER_API_URL.

name: Data Analyzer: A localhost API address is refused when deployed but allowed locally
objective: Proves that in a deployed environment an API address pointing to the same machine (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, 0.0.0.0) is rejected because it could never reach the API, while local development still accepts it. Runs over 5 addresses.
precondition: Offline test harness; settings are passed in as made-up values, no real server or cloud is contacted.

steps.action: Resolve the address when deployed with each localhost-style address.
steps.data: localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, 0.0.0.0 forms, container name set, key set
steps.expected: A configuration error mentioning 'localhost' is raised, and the problems list is exactly ['DATA_ANALYZER_API_URL points at localhost (UI cannot reach the API)'].
The address is returned unchanged apart from any trailing slash removed.

name: Data Analyzer: A container-network service name is accepted as an API address
objective: Proves that an address such as http://api:8000 (used when services run side by side) is not wrongly rejected as localhost.
precondition: Offline test harness; settings are passed in as made-up values, no real server or cloud is contacted.

steps.action: Resolve the address and list problems in production with that address and a key.
steps.data: APP_ENV prod, address http://api:8000, key k
steps.expected: Address is returned as http://api:8000 and the problems list is empty.

name: Data Analyzer: The developer's local web-page template is wired correctly (skipped if the file is absent)
objective: Proves that, where a private local deployment template exists on the machine, it has an https non-localhost API address, takes the key from the named secret, and holds only placeholder secret values. The test is skipped if the file is not present, as in automated builds.
precondition: Only runs if the private file deploy/aca/containerapp-ui.local.yaml exists; otherwise reported as skipped.

steps.action: Read the local template and check its settings.
steps.expected: API address starts with https:// and has no 'localhost'; key refers to secret 'data-analyzer-api-key'; any secret value starts with '<' (a placeholder).
